subject.title: feat(plugins): add Control UI entry points

question: Should external plugin Control UI entry points be allowed to leave the opaque in-app iframe sandbox, or should v1 be fixed to sandboxed in-app launch only?
rationale: This PR defines a public plugin SDK, browser rendering, and Gateway authorization boundary; automation cannot decide whether top-level plugin UI is an accepted product/security model.

options.title: Keep v1 sandboxed
options.body: Ship entry points only as opaque in-app iframes and defer same-window/new-window launch until a trusted-plugin capability is designed.

options.title: Approve trusted top-level launch
options.body: Allow top-level plugin UI only behind an explicit trusted-plugin contract with docs, tests, and security approval.

options.title: Pause for the broader RFC
options.body: Hold this PR until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/71736 settles the contribution-slot browser trust model.

recommendation.title: Keep v1 sandboxed
recommendation.body: Ship entry points only as opaque in-app iframes and defer same-window/new-window launch until a trusted-plugin capability is designed.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged host-hook foundation and the canonical Control UI contribution-slot RFC that this API extends.
